routing_description: Tire pressure warnings, repeated air loss and per-wheel pressure history.
planner_instructions: Compare available tire pressure evidence by wheel and unit. The summary provides compact numerical trends, time spans and supporting observation IDs; history provides individual chronological readings when detailed sequence inspection matters. Use the optional wheel filter only when a particular wheel is relevant; otherwise inspect all available wheels. Neither tool interprets pressure suitability. Do not infer the cause of a change or assume unobserved tires match the observed ones. No vehicle-specific target pressures are supplied. Explain missing history or units as limitations.
